name: Nature Buds Internship
org: Lincoln Park Zoo with After School Matters
what_you_do: Interns help run nature play for the zoo's youngest visitors. There is music, art, story time and sensory bins. Interns also help kids and the adults with them find their way around the zoo.
who_can_apply: You must live in the city of Chicago and go to a Chicago high school. You must be at least 16 by June 1. You must be able to come to all program dates.
pay_detail: Stipend of $17.05 per hour through After School Matters (2026 page)
duration: June to August, Monday to Thursday, 10 a.m. to 2 p.m.
deadline_text: 2026 application opened the week of April 27 on the After School Matters site. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Create an account on the After School Matters website and apply there. Rank "Lincoln Park Zoo - Nature Buds" as your top pick.
notes: Outdoor work. Shifts are four days a week. Pay rate is from the 2026 page and may change. The Illinois FAQ requires work permits only for workers under 16 and refers 16 and 17 year olds to federal rules.
